title: Clinking Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Darting between miniature basalt arches and swaying ribbons of translucent kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its hours sorting luminescent sea glass and sunken watch gears into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics along the sandy floor. Whenever a visitor leans close, ripples of starry bioluminescence cascade across its skin as it proudly taps its favorite treasures together with a faint, cheerful clink.
